_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), by how many things change from one figure to the next. 1: one change (a part moving round, a turn, one more line or side); 2: two changes, or two steps taking turns; 3: three changes, or a rule that skips a figure; 4: four or more parts each moving by its own rule. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
